mapper.select: SELECT tpc.id AS id, tpc.plan_id AS planId, tpc.course_id AS courseId, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.course_name AS courseName, tpc.course_type AS courseType, tpc.suggest_term_no AS suggestTermNo, tpc.credit AS credit FROM training_plan_course tpc JOIN course c ON tpc.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE tpc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY tpc.suggest_term_no, c.course_no
